item: L1 - research UI route and authentication gate
verdict: GATE PROVEN; LOGGED-IN UI RUN BLOCKED — every auth path needs either a credential or a disabled provider

gateTest.title: Sign in — CAERA CADANE
gateTest.note: The route exists and the _authenticated gate refuses unauthenticated access while preserving the intended destination in ?next. Measured live in the browser against the running dev server.

demoRouteChecked.note: The sign-in page offers a no-sign-in demo, which was checked as a possible unauthenticated route to the research panel. ResearchPanel is mounted only in src/routes/_authenticated/ocade.studio.tsx, so the demo does not expose it.

whyNotCompleted: Every sign-in method offered is an OAuth flow or a phone/email one-time code. Completing any of them means handling the owner’s credentials, which I will not do. The research QUERY itself was therefore run through the same pipeline the panel calls — createHttpSourceFetcher and runResearch — against the live network, and is evidenced in release/OCADE_L1_RESEARCH_CITATIONS.json.
ownerActionToComplete: Sign in at /auth, open /ocade/studio, and run a query in the research panel. The pipeline beneath it is already proven on real sources.

credentialFreeAuthProbe.method: POST {SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/signup with an empty body and the publishable key — the documented Supabase anonymous sign-in endpoint
credentialFreeAuthProbe.whyThisWasTried: Anonymous sign-in is the one authentication path that creates a session without any credential — no password, no OAuth, no one-time code. If it were enabled, the research query could have been run through the real logged-in UI without me ever touching the owner’s credentials. It is disabled server-side, so that route is genuinely closed rather than merely inconvenient.
credentialFreeAuthProbe.ownerActionThatWouldUnblock: Enable Anonymous Sign-Ins in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication -> Providers -> Anonymous). That is a single project toggle and requires sharing nothing with me. With it on, L1’s UI clause is completable end to end without credentials.
